text: the reason why having a boyfriend is embarrassing is because y'all came on social media and showed us that it was. if everyone would have kept their low standards to themselves and didn't show us the things they were enduring at home just so they can have a man in their life, people wouldn't think it was embarrassing. but not these videos of your boyfriends and your husbands packing you dog lunches, preparing food for you that i wouldn't even feed my mom's dog, being in relationships with men who you have nothing in common with, coming on the internet and telling us that your boyfriend doesn't shower or wash his ass, seeing the blatant incompetence of these men that y'all are spending your lives with and having children with, of course that shit is embarrassing because y'all keep getting online and showing us how embarrassing it is. all right here we go again another video blaming men for being embarrassing while completely skipping over the fact that the only reason any of this stuff is public is because women keep broadcasting their private relationships to millions of strangers for attention. she's saying having a boyfriend is embarrassing because some women choose low effort incompatible men and then run to the internet to tell everyone how horrible their partner is. that is not reflection of men as a whole, that's a reflection of the choices those women make. and the examples she gives? if your boyfriend doesn't shower why are you still with him? and more importantly why are you telling the entire planet? here's the truth she won't say it's not boyfriends that are embarrassing, it's people who stay with men they don't respect then film the dysfunction for likes. if you keep dating men you have nothing in common with, men who don't care of themselves, men you don't admire, that says something about your standards not about relationships. healthy couples don't upload their worst moments for validation, they communicate, fix issues offline and pick partners they're actually proud of. if your relationship is embarrassing maybe the problem isn't men, maybe the problem is the decisions you keep making and the fact that you won't stop putting them on the internet.
